en_US: Mr. Backlot is the master of this
mansion. This is his office.
This is the way out to the trophy
garden.
The garden is open for all visitors
to enjoy.
However, please beware--wild Pokémon
may appear in the garden.
Welcome.
Here, you may challenge the mansion’s
pride--the five Trainer maids.
The challenge is to beat all five of us
in a row without a break.
In addition to beating us, if you can
beat us in a specific number of turns,
there will be a special gift.
Incidentally, a turn refers to the time
it takes for a Trainer and the opponent
to each make an action.
In this case, action refers to making a
Pokémon use a move, using an item, or
switching a Pokémon.
And now...
The 5-Maid Knockout Exact-Turn Attack
Challenge!
Today’s targeted number of turns is
{STRVAR_1 52, 0, 0}! Would you like to try?
Oh, how disappointing...
Please take the challenge sometime.
Very well!
Our first maid, please!
Congratulations!
You have defeated four maids so far.
You have taken {STRVAR_1 52, 1, 0} turns up to now.
The target is {STRVAR_1 52, 0, 0} turns.
Congratulations for your sweep.
The targeted number of turns was {STRVAR_1 52, 0, 0}.
The number of turns you needed to
defeat the maids was {STRVAR_1 52, 1, 0}.
How splendid of you!
You hit the target!
For making the sweep in the targeted
number of turns, a special gift!
The chance to battle our very own
prodigy, Master Liam!
How splendid of you!
You hit the target!
For making the sweep in the targeted
number of turns, a special gift!
The chance to battle our very own
prodigy, Lady Celeste!
Your splendor is authentic!
Sweeping the floor with the five maids
wasn’t enough for you, oh no!
Why, to think you would triumph over
even our Master Liam!
Your splendor is authentic!
Sweeping the floor with the five maids
wasn’t enough for you, oh no!
Why, to think you would triumph over
even our Lady Celeste!
Ooh...
How disappointing for you.
That said, you swept the five maids.
That’s plenty to be proud of!
I’m so sorry. Everything beyond this
point is strictly off-limits.
Please, you really mustn’t.
Mr. Backlot will be so cross with me!
First up! My favorite color is blue!
I will open the proceedings!
The next person up is quite strong,
really.
I’m pleased to meet you in battle.
My best color is green!
I was no. 2, and a little bit tough!
The next maid is even tougher!
My lucky color is yellow!
The sunshine girl! That’s me!
The next maid is a wee bit stronger
than I am.
Pink is the color I can’t do without!
I’m the fourth in line!

messages.en_US: Th-the next maid up is really strong!

en_US: My symbolic color is red!
Prepare for no. 5!
You knocked out the five of us!
You have to be splendid!
A Trainer would come here and pull me
into a battle...?
I never expected this, but I may as
well enjoy it, don’t you think?
Wonderful!
You’re a marvel of a Trainer!
Oh, I’ll ask you not to pry into what
I’m doing in the back of the mansion.
This knowing wink is all you’ll get out
of me.
Oh, my... You must show me how good
you are for the ladies to call me out.
Oh, my! My, my, my!
Your technique was most enchanting.
I will take my leave now.
Giggle...
The expensive-looking book Mr. Backlot
has... It tugs at my attention.
You’re not allowed through here!
Unless you can beat three of us,
in a row, and in exactly 6 turns.
Fwahahaha!
Are you up to the challenge?
Fwahahaha! Very well then!
Again, you need to beat three of us
in exactly 6 turns! No more, no less!
You beat all three of us!
It took you {STRVAR_1 52, 1, 0} turns in all.
Fwahahaha! That isn’t 6, is it?!
Try again if you want, kiddo!
Oh, hey. Nice job, kiddo.
You met the requirement alright.
But who said we have to keep promises!
Fwahahaha...
Shoot, the space Pokémon escaped!
But you’re still not allowed through!
You’re absolutely not allowed through!
Not that it matters much now...
The Trophy Garden in the back is
chock full of rare Pokémon!
We can sell them for a high price,
and fund our research!
You want to go through? No chance.
I’m not moving an inch.
Not even if I get surrounded by five
dangerous looking Pokémon!
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}: Win in exactly 6 turns?
No way! Watch me! I’ll win in 1 turn!
Who’s got time for 6?
Ugh...
I don’t think this kid understands...
So far, you’ve taken {STRVAR_1 52, 1, 0} turns.
Do you think you’re in good time?
You’ve had {STRVAR_1 52, 1, 0} turns.
Still think you can do it?
You want to play, little kid?
I’ll show you not to mess with us!
Ah... you’re strong.
I’m sorry, Commander Saturn!
What’s that? You wanted a nap?
I’ll give you one--permanently!
Ah... Perhaps I’m the one who
is going to sleep for a while...
You wish to see the lady of the house?
Too bad, she’s busy!

messages.en_US: The lady will see you now...

en_US: The maid in this room has a weird Egg.
It’s blue! With some strange red core!
It’s totally disturbing.
Pokémon Eggs are meant to be yellow!
Gah! At least I don’t need
to look at that Egg anymore...
HAPPINY: Pinny haaa!
It seems to be waiting for more
CLEFAIRY to arrive.
HAPPINY: Pinny haaa!
The HAPPINY seems to be giving
instructions to the CLEFAIRY...
The CLEFAIRY used Metronome!
The CLEFAIRY used Teleport!

messages.en_US: HAPPINY held out something to you...

en_US: {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}: Whew! I thought that wouldn’t
ever end!
Keeping to turn limits is hard!
So, have we beat all the goons?
Or are there still more?
Hm? Who are you children?
Where are the grunts I left?
Backlot: Yes, yes, I suppose I must...
Ah... My poor Pokémon Mansion...
You... I recognise your face!
You’re the child who raided the
Team Galactic Building in Eterna!
Humph! Anything that continues to
oppose Team Galactic must be crushed!
Come, Mr. Backlot. You’ll help me eject
these children from your home, yes?
Backlot: Ahh! I would prefer not...
But I suppose I must...
My poor beautiful Pokémon, used for
such a boorish task...
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}: OK, {STRVAR_1 3, 1, 0}, no problem!
Let’s team up and win this!
We can just heal the old man’s Pokémon
afterwards! Don’t worry about him!
Gah! What makes you so tough?
Not to mention this old man is
completely useless.
Fine, we’ll leave. We’ve bargained with
this old man for the riches we need.
Next time, you won’t be so lucky.
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}: There, {STRVAR_1 3, 1, 0}, all sorted!
Now it’s time to dash!
I’m off to Solaceon Town!
See ya, {STRVAR_1 3, 1, 0}!
You’ll be shocked by my growth the
next time we meet!
Backlot: That friend of yours takes
off very quickly, doesn’t he?
Thank you for coming to the aid
of my Pokémon Mansion.
Those Team Galactic people wanted some
of my most valuable objects.
With their threats against my lovely
staff and the people of this mansion,
I had no choice but to co-operate...
Alas, I’m sure things will mostly
return to normal, now.
There’s one particularly valuable item
that was not taken by them.
It is an unusual deep blue Pokémon Egg.
Looking at it is like looking straight
into the sea.
Please come and see it in my office
on the right when you’re ready.
Oh, and please do visit the
Trophy Garden in the back.
The wild Pokémon in there are
simply exquisite!
